definitions.definition: An organized culture encompassing many communities, often on the scale of a nation or a people; a stage or system of social, political, or technical development.

quote.citation: 1981, William Irwin Thompson, The Time Falling Bodies Take to Light: Mythology, Sexuality and the Origins of Culture, London: Rider/Hutchinson & Co., pages rise and fall:
quote.text: But civilizations, like the penis, rise and fall, and when the towers and battlements crumble into the earth, they return to the embrace of the Great Mother.

quote.citation: 1936, Rollo Ahmed, The Black Art, London: Long, page 159:
quote.text: Civilisation has imbued man's minds with false ideas of the evil of sex and its fulfilment.

definitions.definition: The act or process of civilizing or becoming civilized.
The state or quality of being civilized.
(obsolete) The act of rendering a criminal process civil.
